welcomeCard.title: Welcome to ADHDCal ✨
welcomeCard.body: Your calm space to plan, focus and celebrate small wins. We'll build it together, one gentle step at a time.

intentions: You don't have to do it all — just the next small thing.
Progress, not perfection. You're doing great.
One step at a time is still moving forward.
Be kind to yourself today. You're enough.
Small wins count. Let's find one together.
Showing up is the hardest part — and you're here.
